learning_outcomes.text: Study and understand programs in C.
Write programs in C, compile them and produce independent applications.
Use compilers and more advanced development tools.
Perform dynamic memory management wherever necessary.
Program in the system level through basic POSIX calls.
Store and retrieve data to/from secondary storage programmatically, through text and binary files.
Select and apply the most appropriate interprocess communication mechanism.

syllabus_topics: Basic C (basic data types, expressions, operators, control flow, functions)
Advanced elements (structs, unions, bitwise operators, variadic functions)
Interprocess communication (unnamed and named pipes, message queues, shared memory)
Advanced topics (security, assembly language, development tools for large projects)
teaching_methods: Use of computers during the Lab practice
Course website maintenance with announcements and posting of teaching material (lecture slides and notes)
Announcement of assessment marks via the ecourse platform by UOI
Use of email for communicating with students

assessment_methods.method: Final examination (multiple-choice questions and program development)

assessment_rules: Two in-Lab midterms count for 40% and the final exam counts for 60% in the course grade. The final exam consists of two parts: multiple-choice questions and program development on a computer. Evaluation is conducted in Greek.
